results.title: Dial 1975
results.overview: In 1975, India was declared in a state of emergency. This movie tells a story of that year and how the first mobile phone arrived to India.

results.title: Too Late
results.overview: Two puppets, Isabella and Chris, sit in a parked car at night at the end of their relationship. A metal betrayal from someone in their past has driven a wedge between them.

results.title: Zohra on the Road
results.overview: From the moment she’s been living alone in her isolated country house, Zohra, an old granny with a punch, has been determined to get her driver’s licence. Despite her teacher’s skepticism, she’s sure of one thing : she wants to ride her late husband’s Alfa Romeo.

results.title: Wallah
results.overview: Alaeddine spends his days in Epinay-sur-Seine, lying to the north of Paris. With urban imagery, poetic digressions and scenes from everyday life, the film tells the story of the condition of extraneousness in a land far from one’s own, the loneliness imposed by metropolises such as Paris, the need to feel part of a community and the quest for personal balance, between cultural rootedness and discovery of the Other.

results.title: On Being Almost
results.overview: After speaking at a literary forum alongside renowned novelist Robert Hausu, Malik dares to send his manuscript, The Anatomy of an Owl. Driven by a longing for recognition, he slips into a gathering of writers and filmmakers at a café, where his ambition slowly collides with reality.

results.title: Everything That's Wrong with You
results.original_title: Vse, kar je narobe s tabo
results.overview: After the emotional collapse that follows her mother’s death, Maruša builds an online bond with Alja, a nurse living in a small coastal town in Germany. Bonding through humor over their shared struggles, Maruša and Alja quickly develop a friendship that is put to the test when they finally meet in person.

results.title: Blade Warrior of Blade Action
results.overview: Under the careful planning and command of Director Chen Hai’an, the special police unit to which Cheng Gang belongs to engages in a thrilling battle of wits and courage against a smuggling syndicate led by Huang Zan. The officers, especially Cheng Gang and Shen Xin, make tremendous sacrifices and selfless contributions to crack the cultural relics case and wipe out the criminals. In the end, they succeed in capturing the entire criminal group in one sweep.

results.title: Seafarers
results.overview: Amorous sailors bite off more than they can chew when they stop into a seaside pub.

results.title: no pressure healing
results.overview: After a sexual trauma, Noah is affected by post-traumatic stress disorder. Yet he does not give up hope of reclaiming his connection to his sexuality.

results.title: Before We Leave Tuscany
results.overview: A weary mother seeking solace retreats to a serene Tuscan villa, where the adorable Italian innkeeper and a handsome novelist with writer's block, draw her into a story of unexpected connection and renewal.

results.title: The Space We Call Home
results.overview: In the not-too-distant future, humans want to set foot on Mars, even colonize the hostile planet. The studies on this endeavor offer surprising perspectives on the ecological crisis on Earth. Discussing space travel, architecture, ecology, and the cities of tomorrow, this documentary essay unfolds a philosophical mosaic about our living spaces. What begins as a technological utopia leads to the central questions of our time. How do we want to live, work, and do business in the future?

results.title: Beyond Files
results.overview: Case files document encounters with alien forces and altered realities, uncovering a pattern beyond human understanding.

results.title: The Wedding
results.overview: Felisa, a hairdresser who lives with her mother, agrees to marry the son of a client despite his initial resistance.

results.title: Maragatha Malai
results.overview: Set in the 18th century, Maragatha Malai follows a zamindar, Parthiban, who protects his ancestral treasure from a ruthless gang led by Kabala Vendan. During the conflict, his family gets separated when his young son goes missing in the forest. Years later, through struggle, fate, and divine grace, the family reunites and safeguards their legacy in this period fantasy adventure.

results.title: Golem
results.overview: The village idiot lives in a hut with his sick mother. His neighbors are the Jewish family of the local blacksmith Mendel, and the guy is secretly in love with his youngest daughter Sonya.

results.title: The Decay
results.overview: In a declining medical centre, a desperate patient must convince an embittered GP to diagnose her disturbing symptoms before a deadly plague consumes them both.
